cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 205°C (400°F) and position rack in the center of the oven. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
12 caps portobello mushrooms
¾ small pkg fresh basil
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Remove the mushroom stems and carefully scrape out the gills; discard stems and gills.

Place mushrooms, cap-side up, onto the baking sheet pan and season with oil, salt, and pepper; turn mushrooms over and bake for 10 minutes. When the mushrooms are done, remove from the oven and set aside to cool slightly.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Slice the sausage into ½-inch-thick rounds.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage slices to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sausage slices are browned, about 5 minutes; remove from heat.
Grate the cheese and transfer to a large bowl.
Pick the basil leaves off the stems; discard the stems and slice the leaves into a chiffonade by stacking them and rolling tightly into a cigar, then slicing crosswise into thin ribbons.
Peel and mince garlic; transfer to another large bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic; whisk to combine. Add mixed greens to the bowl; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ cup red wine vinegar
⅜ tsp oregano
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Combine tomato paste and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 tbsp tomato paste
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: When the mushrooms are cool enough to handle, carefully lift each cap with a spatula and tip the juices out into the sink; return mushrooms, cap-side down, to the baking sheet pan. Blot the inside of each cap with a paper towel before filling.

Fill each mushroom cap with 1½ tbsp tomato paste mixture. Divide cheese and sausage between mushrooms, then return to the oven and bake until cheese is melted and mushrooms are heated through, about 5 minutes.
To serve, divide mushroom pizzas and salad between plates; sprinkle basil over the mushrooms and enjoy.
